messages.subject: Error: datetime column must be a factor or character: recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to get the activity using Kernel's density but when I use the "activityDensity" function, this message show up:

Error: datetime column must be a factor or character: recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]

Also: Warning message:

In if (!class(inputColumn) %in% c("factor", "character")) stop(paste("datetime column must be a factor or character:",  :

The condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used”


Does anyone know why this happens and how I can fix it?


Thanks

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error: datetime column must be a factor or character: recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]
parts:
Hi Alejandra,
in your call to activityDensity, you don't define the argument recordDateTimeCol. Therefore, the function will use the default,
recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal"

Normally that should be fine, since the column "DateTimeOriginal" is in the output of recordTableIndividual, and in the correct format also. Can you please share

str(osoind) 

so I can check the record table is in order? I'm perplexed by the warning message you shared (" The condition has length > 1 ..." ) and don't know why that would appear. Hopefully it becomes apparent from str()
Thank you,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error: datetime column must be a factor or character: recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]
parts:
Hi Alejandra, 
you need to assign the edit to the record table before running activityDensity, otherwise nothing will change:

osoind$Date.Time <- as.character(osoind$Date.Time)

Now the Date.Time column in osind is a character, and you can (hopefully) run activityDensity.

Best,
Jürgen

El jueves, 21 de enero de 2021 a las 2:54:18 UTC-6, Juergen Niedballa escribió:
Hi Alejandra, 
you need to assign the edit to the record table before running activityDensity, otherwise nothing will change:

osoind$Date.Time <- as.character(osoind$Date.Time)

Now the Date.Time column in osind is a character, and you can (hopefully) run activityDensity.

Best,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error: datetime column must be a factor or character: recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]
parts:
Hi,
the column "Date.Time" doesn't exist in the osoind data frame, hence the error. See str() you shared above. The proper date/time column is called "DateTimeOriginal". That's what camtrapR will use by default. Since that column is POSIXct for you (which is odd but let's just ignore that for now), please convert it to character before running activityDensity. This should be the whole workflow:

osoind <- recordTableIndividual (...)   # as above

osoind$DateTimeOriginal <- as.character(osoind$DateTimeOriginal)   # convert to character

activityDensity(...)   # as above

If it still doesn't work, please share small example of your record table as csv (just a few rows, not the whole table). 
Best regards,
Jürgen
